-# 逮捕 (たいほ) - arrest
-
-## Meaning
-
-逮捕 is an arrest or apprehension. 逮捕する is a transitive suru verb: **person を逮捕する**, "arrest someone."
-
-- 警察は容疑者を逮捕しました。 (けいさつはようぎしゃをたいほしました。) - The police arrested the suspect.
-- 容疑者が逮捕されたとニュースで聞きました。 (ようぎしゃがたいほされたとニュースでききました。) - I heard on the news that the suspect had been arrested.
-
-The second example uses 逮捕される, the passive "be arrested." If the arresting party is named in a passive sentence, it can take に: 警察に逮捕される.
-
-## How the kanji combine
-
-逮 contributes apprehending or catching up with someone, and [捕](../kanji/捕.md) contributes catching or seizing. The two elements reinforce the idea of apprehension. The on readings are タイ + ホ.
-
-## Synonyms and antonyms
-
-[捕まえる](捕まえる.md) (つかまえる) is broader "catch; capture" and can apply outside police work. 釈放 (しゃくほう), "release from custody," describes movement in the opposite direction within a legal process.
-
-## Distinctive meaning
-
-逮捕 names the act of taking someone into custody. It does not by itself establish guilt or mean that a court has convicted the person. In ordinary news reading, keep "suspect," "arrest," and "conviction" conceptually separate rather than treating them as equivalent stages.
-
-Dictionary: [JMdict](https://www.edrdg.org/wiki/index.php/JMdict-EDICT_Dictionary_Project), entry 1411470, sense 1.

+# 逮捕 (たいほ) - arrest
+
+## Meaning
+
+逮捕 is an arrest or apprehension. 逮捕する is a transitive suru verb: **person を逮捕する**, "arrest someone."
+
+- 警察は容疑者を逮捕しました。 (けいさつはようぎしゃをたいほしました。) - The police arrested the suspect.
+- 容疑者が逮捕されたとニュースで聞きました。 (ようぎしゃがたいほされたとニュースでききました。) - I heard on the news that the suspect had been arrested.
+
+The second example uses 逮捕される, the passive "be arrested." If the arresting party is named in a passive sentence, it can take に: 警察に逮捕される.
+
+## How the kanji combine
+
+[逮](../kanji/逮.md) contributes apprehending or catching up with someone, and [捕](../kanji/捕.md) contributes catching or seizing. The two elements reinforce the idea of apprehension. The on readings are タイ + ホ.
+
+## Synonyms and antonyms
+
+[捕まえる](捕まえる.md) (つかまえる) is broader "catch; capture" and can apply outside police work. 釈放 (しゃくほう), "release from custody," describes movement in the opposite direction within a legal process.
+
+## Distinctive meaning
+
+逮捕 names the act of taking someone into custody. It does not by itself establish guilt or mean that a court has convicted the person. In ordinary news reading, keep "suspect," "arrest," and "conviction" conceptually separate rather than treating them as equivalent stages.
+
+Dictionary: [JMdict](https://www.edrdg.org/wiki/index.php/JMdict-EDICT_Dictionary_Project), entry 1411470, sense 1.
The Joyo table lists タイ in 逮捕. KANJIDIC2 records no kun or name reading for this character.
- [捕](捕.md) means capture, while [追](追.md) means chase or pursue. An arrest and a chase are not the same event.

１ 及ぶ。「逮夜」
２ 相手に手が届く。捕らえる。「逮捕」
- [回](回.md) includes revolving and [周](周.md) includes a circuit; these overlap the going-around sense of 循 without implying that every movement forms a cycle.
追 is following after something, often in pursuit.

comparisons.reason: Possible overlap between arrest (take into custody, or stop) and 留's keep-in-place, stay and と.める/と.まる senses. 監 cites 留 for "detaining or keeping in place" (repo/kanji/監.md:146-151).
comparisons.disposition: UNVERIFIED. 留's own text gives only retain, stay and fasten (repo/kanji/留.md:3, repo/kanji/留.md:20-22). No JMdict family for 留 or its detention compounds was supplied, so whether "arrest" is a defensible answer for 留 is unsettled. The pair is declared on neither endpoint (snapshot/kanji/逮.md:14, repo/kanji/留.md:11); 逮's curated options do not currently expose it.

comparisons.reason: Hunting a suspect: "chase" vs searching, plus police-investigation context (捜査) (repo/kanji/捜.md:20).
comparisons.disposition: Harmless. Searching seeks something whose location is unknown, while chasing pursues a target in view. The card notes that searching does not imply catching or finding. Shared crime context alone does not decide this (REVIEW.md:21-22). Declared on neither endpoint.

comparisons.reason: Same seek-vs-chase comparison; 探る means probe or investigate (repo/kanji/探.md:20-22).
comparisons.disposition: Harmless for the same reason as D2. No pursue, catch or arrest sense appears in 探's text. Declared on neither endpoint.

comparisons.reason: 逮's "chase" against 循's "follow". JMdict 追う glosses chase as "follow after" (evidence/jmdict-families.xml:217-224), and 循 itself excludes 追 because 追 includes following (repo/kanji/循.md:15, repo/kanji/循.md:43).
comparisons.disposition: Harmless, medium confidence. 循 means following a course, rule or cycle (repo/kanji/循.md:24), which matches 追う sense 2, "follow a set order" (evidence/jmdict-families.xml:225-229). None of 逮's evidence gives a follow or cycle sense (evidence/external-snapshots/01-extract.txt:7-8, evidence/kanjidic2-records.xml:56-57). Declared on neither endpoint; see O4.

comparisons.reason: Seize or hold down a person: 押さえる "hold down" (repo/kanji/押.md:22).
comparisons.disposition: Harmless. The displayed title "push" and the documented hold-down/keep-steady senses do not give arrest or chase. The opened evidence contains no arrest sense for 押. Declared on neither endpoint.

comparisons.reason: English "arrest" in the sense of checking progress, against obstruct or hinder (repo/kanji/障.md:3, repo/kanji/障.md:20-21).
comparisons.disposition: Harmless. 逮's card itself says arrest-as-stop does not make 逮捕 a word for stopping (snapshot/kanji/逮.md:44). Hindering is impeding, not apprehending or chasing, and 障's senses (malfunction, obstacle, screen) contain no custody or pursuit sense. Declared on neither endpoint; 障's exclusions are 害, 防 and 関 only.

comparisons.reason: Reach (及ぶ) against draw near, and stop by against arrest-as-stop (repo/kanji/寄.md:20-22).
comparisons.disposition: Harmless. Approaching or dropping in is neither reaching a limit or extent nor apprehending someone. The "stop" in "stop by" means visiting, not halting someone. Declared on neither endpoint.
Harmless. 逮's displayed title has no capture or obtain label, and 得 covers obtaining or advantage, not seizing a person. Declared on neither endpoint.

comparisons.reason: 逮's Daijisen sense 1, 及ぶ "reach", against passing beyond. JMdict supplies both families (evidence/jmdict-families.xml:25-130).
comparisons.disposition: Harmless. 過ぎる glosses are pass, elapse and exceed, while 及ぶ glosses are reach and extend. Reaching a point is not going past it, and 逮's displayed title does not include reach. Declared on neither endpoint.
Harmless for the same reach-vs-beyond reason as D9. The 越える glosses are cross over and go beyond. Declared on neither endpoint.
Harmless for the same reason as D9. Declared on neither endpoint.

comparisons.reason: Custody and confinement: 監禁 confinement, and Daijisen's prison branch (repo/kanji/監.md:28-35).
comparisons.disposition: Harmless. 監's confinement compounds hold people after the fact, and the card distinguishes them from supervision. 監 has no apprehend or chase sense, and its 76-item exclusion list omits 逮 (repo/kanji/監.md:14). Declared on neither endpoint.

comparisons.reason: Verifies 逮's note that 捕 means capture, and the constituent statement in 逮捕.
comparisons.disposition: Already handled. 捕's text matches "catching or capturing" (repo/kanji/捕.md:3, repo/kanji/捕.md:20). The pair is declared on 逮 (snapshot/kanji/逮.md:14).

comparisons.reason: Verifies 逮's note that 追 means chase or pursue, against 逮's own "chase" title.
comparisons.disposition: Already handled. The identical "chase" label makes exclusion necessary (repo/kanji/追.md:3, repo/kanji/追.md:20), and the pair is declared on 逮 (snapshot/kanji/逮.md:14). See O3 for the wording.
